back.text: The garden gate latch kept catching on a chip of gravel wedged under the strike plate. I dug it out with my thumbnail and the bolt dropped home clean.

smooth.text: I can hear the cars on the gravel now. My mouth is dry and my hands won't stay still. I said things to Kitty I can't take back.

rough.text: My pipe is cold and my hands are still shaking. The gate latch fought me over a chip of gravel. Guests are in the house and I want the hedge.
